data.title: Build Your First Website
data.outcome: Work with an Agent to build a clearly structured, usable website that you can verify yourself.
intentExamples: I want to build a website
Build a web page from scratch
I don't know what to learn first to build a website

stages.title: Understand the parts of a web page
stages.action: Identify the main areas of the current page and explain what each one does.
stages.evidence: You can tell page structure, visual styling, and interactive behavior apart.

lessons.title: Frontend
lessons.tagline: The layer people directly see, click, and type into

lessons.title: HTML
lessons.tagline: Describe the structure and meaning of a web page

lessons.title: Single Page
lessons.tagline: Arrange a complete story in sections down one scrolling page

stages.title: Put content in a clear reading order
stages.action: Arrange and group headings, body copy, cards, and calls to action.
stages.evidence: Someone opening the page for the first time can identify its focus and the next step.

lessons.title: Typography
lessons.tagline: Use text size and style to show what matters first

lessons.title: Space
lessons.tagline: Use empty space to show which things belong together

lessons.title: Flex
lessons.tagline: Arrange items along one row or one column

lessons.title: Grid
lessons.tagline: Plan rows and columns as one layout system

stages.title: Make buttons, links, and forms actually work
stages.action: Connect one primary button, one page navigation link, and one form submission.
stages.evidence: All three actions produce real results that match their labels.

lessons.title: Button
lessons.tagline: Click to save, submit, delete, or run another action

lessons.title: Link
lessons.tagline: Click to open another page, location, or file

lessons.title: Form
lessons.tagline: Collect several fields and submit them as one task

stages.title: Show users what the system is doing
stages.action: Add waiting, success, error, and no-content states to the main flow.
stages.evidence: Each state can be triggered, seen, and recovered from.

lessons.title: Spinner
lessons.tagline: A rotating indicator that shows a short, indeterminate wait

lessons.title: Alert
lessons.tagline: Keep an important message or warning visible on the page

lessons.title: Empty
lessons.tagline: Explain why no data is shown and what to do next

lessons.title: Result
lessons.tagline: Explain the final outcome and the next available step

stages.title: Keep the page readable and tappable on phones
stages.action: Check the navigation, text, buttons, and content layout at a phone width.
stages.evidence: Nothing overflows horizontally, and primary actions are not blocked.

lessons.title: Flex
lessons.tagline: Arrange items along one row or one column

lessons.title: Grid
lessons.tagline: Plan rows and columns as one layout system

lessons.title: Drawer
lessons.tagline: Slide in a side panel without leaving the current page

lessons.title: Text Truncate
lessons.tagline: Shorten text that cannot fit in the available space
